title: OBJECTIVE LINES IN CAPS
why: His order of 2026-10-09: raid text reads like a shooter HUD, a short caps headline with a short detail only when needed. His contract line is split at his own colon for display: CONTRACT DONE is the headline and the rest, word for word with his lowercase mainframe, is the detail. A machine kill read Warden X-4 is down. Its core is exposed. and Pillbox A-2 has stopped singing.; they now read WARDEN X-4 DESTROYED and PILLBOX A-2 DESTROYED with the cache or the wreck as the detail, and THE OVERSEER is said once as THE OVERSEER DESTROYED with Its hoard is open. Doors read ARCHIVE DOOR OPEN, the seal SEAL BROKEN, a dead hire NAME IS DEAD with You owe his family., the lightning cache LIGHTNING FUSED A CACHE, and the hot ground HOT GROUND and HOT GROUND MOVED with their details.
now: Contract, kill, door, seal and hot ground lines read as caps callouts, with his contract words kept whole as the detail.
